test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph presents the quantity of biscuits exported (in lakh tons) and their value (in crore ₹) over the given years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c810ec1d0293c8b0d241374ab1c0f9f091519a3dd576fead88e3d587c7249b92.png] 

What was the percentage increase in value of the biscuits exported from 1985 to 1987 (correct to 2 decimal places)?
solution:
**Given:**

Value of biscuits exported in 1985 = ₹330 crore.

Value of biscuits exported in 1987 = ₹490 crore.

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Increase = ((New Value - Old Value) / Old Value) × 100

**Calculation:**

Old Value = ₹330 crore

New Value = ₹490 crore

Percentage Increase = ((490 - 330) / 330) × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = (160 / 330) × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 0.4848 × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 48.48%

**The percentage increase in the value of biscuits exported from 1985 to 1987 is 48.48%.**
